_note: House destruction (docs/house-destruction.md Contract 5). carve.by_source: carve radius in metres by blast source, else splash radius * default_share; 0 = no carve. materials: resist (1.0 = the radius as is, 0 = never carved; read in 1/16 units), weight and strength (load before a cell crumbles) per cell material. support: passes of detach + load, span_cells (0 = off). fracture: Voronoi pieces of a fallen part. debris: the client's cosmetic debris; rubble fade|stay (/rubble overrides it for the round). ram: a vehicle at min_speed m/s or more (13.9 = 50 km/h) cuts its way through a hollow house: before each move the cells its box (plus margin_m on the sides and top) sweeps over two steps plus lead_m are cut, nearest first, each costing momentum_per_cell * resist of its momentum (mass * speed); short of momentum it stops in the wall. Once cutting it goes on down to keep_speed. The support pass runs every settle_ticks ticks and when the cutting stops. An aircraft rams on impact (the speed the wall took, looked for probe_m ahead).
